append.detail: A website guest booking is now a 30 minute PENDING hold with a one-time confirm token (migration 20270346008300: guest_confirm_token, guest_confirm_expires_at, guest_confirmed_at, guest_opt_in). createGuestBooking sends only a Confirm your booking email to the typed address; confirmGuestBooking (confirmGuestBookingAction, the website's /confirm-booking?token= page) flips the hold to confirmed, sends the booking confirmation and reminder, and records captureLead with the parked opt-in. A live hold blocks its slot; an expired one drops out of the open-slot read and is released before the next placement. Hosts see a live hold as awaiting the guest's confirmation. Vitest covers hold, no lead on create, lead on confirm, expired token refused, live hold blocks, expired hold frees; pgTAP pins the columns and the slot index.
